name: Cable Close-Grip Curl
steps: Stand facing a low pulley on a cable machine and grasp the straight or EZ attachment palms-up with hands closer than shoulder width.
Pin your elbows tightly to your ribs and brace your core.
Curl the attachment smoothly upward toward your shoulders by flexing strictly at the elbows.
Lower the bar slowly back to thigh level without letting the weight stack touch down.
tips: Keep your wrists straight in line with your forearms rather than bending them back.
Avoid leaning backward or swinging your elbows forward as the bar rises.
